brief: A 3D-printed PLA spacer block. The base is a 30 mm square plate 4 mm thick. A 12 mm diameter post 10 mm tall stands in the middle of it, with a 2 mm fillet where the post meets the plate. A 5 mm hole runs all the way through the post and the plate. Two 3 mm mounting holes pass all the way through the plate, 20 mm apart. It must weigh no more than 8 g. It carries no load - it is a printed spacer, so there is no load case.
